summary: First-iteration testing of Saturn Max Technologies full-stack app. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass — /api/health reports email_configured=false (Resend key blank by design), 5 seeded jobs, job 404 works, POST /api/applications succeeds and auto-creates candidate + activity without crashing on missing Resend key, POST /api/contact persists, dashboard for rahul@email.com returns 4 apps / 5 activity / stats {applications_sent:4, interviews_scheduled:1, profile_views:18, profile_complete_percent:72}, unknown candidate returns 404. Frontend: Playwright end-to-end flow passed for Home (hero, 5 job rows, Apply preselects position, application + contact forms show success toasts), Login (tabs, Google/LinkedIn placeholder no-nav, demo-login-cta routes to /dashboard), Dashboard (greeting with Rahul, 4 stat cards, profile checklist, messages badge '3'), all dashboard sub-pages (jobs 5/5, applications AI/ML & Full Stack, profile 72%, messages, settings save toast), Sign out clears session and returns to / with 'Signed out' toast. Zero browser console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~730 lines; consider splitting into routers (jobs, applications, contact, dashboard) and separate email/seed modules before it grows further.
DashboardStats.profile_views and profile_views_delta_week are hardcoded (18 / 5). Fine for MVP but flag for real analytics later.

send_email_async uses asyncio.create_task without storing the reference — if the event loop is under load these tasks may be GC'd. Low priority for MVP but worth a background task set or BackgroundTasks in FastAPI.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; browsers will ignore credentialed requests. Consider restricting origins before production.
HomePage.js is large and does both layout and API calls — split services/jobs/forms into components for maintainability.
OAuth (Google/LinkedIn) and email/password login are UI-only placeholders per user's request; clearly documented as MOCKED (Firebase wiring pending by user).
test_credentials: No auth required. Seeded demo candidate email: rahul@email.com (no password; dashboard bootstraps session automatically).
seed_data_creation: MongoDB is seeded on backend startup with 5 jobs, 1 candidate (Rahul Sharma), 4 applications, 5 activity entries. Test file inserts additional TEST_* applications/contacts that are safe to leave (prefixed and uniquely ID'd).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 backend pytest tests and full Playwright UI flow (home → application → contact → login → demo → dashboard → all 5 sub-pages → signout) passed with zero console errors. Resend key is intentionally blank; do NOT treat email_configured=false or skipped emails as failures. Key data-testids: job-row-{id}, job-apply-{id}, application-full-name/email/phone/experience/position/portfolio/introduction/submit, contact-name/email/subject(select)/message/submit, nav-login-link, tab-signin/signup, oauth-google/linkedin, demo-login-cta, nav-dashboard/jobs/applications/messages/profile/settings, sign-out-button, save-email-prefs. Mocked: Google/LinkedIn OAuth buttons, email/password login, forgot password (all placeholder toasts). Resend emails skipped gracefully.
